description: This Java class implements the EmailReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve email message data from a database, including fetching all emails, specific emails by ID, and filtering by status and date. It uses JDBC for database access and includes an inner class for mapping result set rows to EmailData objects.

classes.name: EmailReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing email data retrieval operations from the database, including fetching all emails, specific email by ID, and filtering by status and date.

classes.name: EmailMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to EmailData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches all email records from the database.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Fetches a single email record by its resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllPending
methods.description: Retrieves all emails with status 'Pending' based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves all emails with status 'Sent' based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveExternalIdsOfAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves external IDs of all sent emails, limited by the specified number.

methods.name: retrieveAllDelivered
methods.description: Retrieves all emails with status 'Delivered' limited by the specified number.

methods.name: retrieveAllFailed
methods.description: Retrieves all emails with status 'Failed' based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveEmailByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves emails filtered by status and date range, with pagination support.
